targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM nodes
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM nodes WHERE last_seen_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '2 minutes'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM nodes WHERE last_seen_at IS NULL OR last_seen_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (fingerprint) state FROM alert_events ORDER BY fingerprint, received_at DESC) latest WHERE state = 'firing'

SELECT n.name, n.environment, n.hostname, CASE WHEN n.last_seen_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '2 minutes' THEN 'online' WHEN n.last_seen_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes' THEN 'degraded' ELSE 'offline' END AS status, n.last_seen_at, ROUND(m.cpu_percent::numeric, 1) AS cpu_percent, ROUND((100.0 * m.memory_used_bytes / NULLIF(m.memory_total_bytes, 0))::numeric, 1) AS memory_percent, ROUND((100.0 * m.disk_used_bytes / NULLIF(m.disk_total_bytes, 0))::numeric, 1) AS disk_percent, n.agent_version FROM nodes n LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM metric_samples WHERE node_id = n.id ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1) m ON TRUE ORDER BY n.name
